# 📸 Clinic Images Directory

Place all your real photographs, logos, and medical graphics in this folder:  
`public/images/`

Any image placed here can be accessed directly anywhere in the website using `/images/your-image-name.ext`.

---

## 📋 Recommended Image Filenames & Specifications

To easily replace the placeholders with your original high-resolution photos, use these filenames:

| Item | Recommended Filename | Ideal Resolution / Aspect Ratio | Purpose in Website |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Official Clinic Logo** | `logo.png` or `logo.svg` | Transparent background, ~500x120px or square 512x512px | Header navbar, Hero & Footer branding |
| **Doctor Photograph** | `doctor.jpg` or `doctor.png` | Portrait (vertical 4:5 or 1:1 square, min 800x1000px) | About Dr. Mohammad Fahad Alam profile card |
| **Clinic Treatment Area** | `clinic-interior.jpg` | Landscape (16:9 or 4:3, min 1200x800px) | Treatment room & patient consultation area slot |
| **Exercise & Rehab Bay** | `exercise-bay.jpg` | Landscape (16:9 or 4:3, min 1200x800px) | Rehabilitation equipment & physical exercise bay |
| **Home Visit Care Photo** | `home-visit.jpg` | Landscape (16:9, min 1200x800px) | Dedicated home visit banner section |
| **Spine & Ortho Care** | `spine-care.jpg` | Landscape / Square (min 800x800px) | Services section condition cards |

---

## 🚀 How It Works
1. Simply copy/paste your image files into this folder (`public/images/`).
2. Supported formats: `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`, `.svg`.
3. In your React components, reference them with `/images/filename.jpg`.
